data.title: Care & Maintenance
data.description: Preserve the beauty of your Furalto pieces with proper care by material and room type.

sections.title: Fabric & Upholstery
sections.body: Vacuum regularly with an upholstery attachment. Blot spills immediately; professional cleaning recommended annually.

sections.title: Wood & Stone
sections.body: Use coasters and felt pads. Dust with a soft cloth; avoid harsh chemicals on oiled wood and sealed stone.

title: Care: Outdoor
description: Edit the Care: Outdoor page content shown on the website.

data.title: Outdoor Furniture Care
data.description: Protect teak, woven cord, and performance fabrics from weather and UV exposure.

sections.title: Seasonal Protection
sections.body: Use breathable covers during monsoon months. Store cushions indoors when not in use.

sections.title: Teak Maintenance
sections.body: Teak develops a natural silver patina. Apply teak oil annually if you prefer the original golden tone.

title: Care: Living
description: Edit the Care: Living page content shown on the website.

data.title: Living Room Care
data.description: Care instructions for sofas, sectionals, coffee tables, and media consoles.

sections.title: Upholstery
sections.body: Rotate cushions monthly. Avoid direct sunlight to prevent fading on linen and bouclé fabrics.

sections.title: Marble & Wood Tables
sections.body: Wipe spills on marble immediately. Use placemats and trivets to protect wood and stone surfaces.

title: Care: Bedroom
description: Edit the Care: Bedroom page content shown on the website.

data.title: Bedroom Furniture Care
data.description: Maintain beds, nightstands, and wardrobes for years of daily use.

sections.title: Beds & Bedding
sections.body: Rotate mattresses seasonally. Follow fabric care labels for headboard upholstery.

sections.title: Storage Pieces
sections.body: Avoid overloading drawers. Use drawer liners for delicate finishes and brass hardware.

title: Care: Dining
description: Edit the Care: Dining page content shown on the website.

data.title: Dining Furniture Care
data.description: Care for dining tables, chairs, and sideboards.

sections.title: Stone & Wood Tables
sections.body: Use table pads for formal dining. Clean with pH-neutral products only.

sections.title: Chair Upholstery
sections.body: Vacuum dining chair seats weekly. Treat stains promptly with approved fabric cleaner.

title: Care: Bath
description: Edit the Care: Bath page content shown on the website.

data.title: Bath Furniture Care
data.description: Protect vanities and storage from humidity and water exposure.

sections.title: Vanity Surfaces
sections.body: Wipe condensation after use. Avoid abrasive cleaners on lacquer and stone tops.

title: Care: Rugs
description: Edit the Care: Rugs page content shown on the website.

data.title: Rug Care Guide
data.description: Extend the life of natural fiber and wool rugs with proper maintenance.

sections.title: Regular Care
sections.body: Vacuum without a beater bar. Rotate rugs every six months to ensure even wear.

sections.title: Professional Cleaning
sections.body: Schedule professional cleaning every 12–18 months depending on foot traffic.

sections.title: Warm vs Cool Light
sections.body: Living and bedroom spaces benefit from 2700K warm light. Kitchen and task areas may use 3000K.
